requirements.requirement: Motor vehicles being driven upon any highway outside of a business district in a caravan or motorcade, whether or not towing other vehicles, shall be operated to allow sufficient space between each such vehicle or combination of vehicles so as to enable any other vehicle or combination of vehicles to enter and occupy such space without danger.
Space permits another vehicle or combination to enter and occupy without danger; preserve observations without declaring danger threshold.
Outside-business-district highway, caravan or motorcade, with and without towing.
